purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and schema-first anonymous geometry review.
assessment: Cheongju City’s official Mapmoa GIS, managed by the city’s Cadastral Information Division, provides citywide map layers and real-estate information. The city says it presents land-register, public land-price, land-use and history information. This confirms a local cadastral-information custodian and parcel-map candidate, but not an anonymous schema-safe parcel-vector service. The official map viewer and its user guide were reviewed, but no public vector service schema that allows requesting polygon geometry with only safe native cadastral keys was confirmed. No property-specific query or owner lookup was made.
